{{Recipe}}

The following recipe is for crispy homemade '''potato chips'''.

'''Potato chips''' are thin slices of potato that are deep-fried or baked until they become crispy and golden.

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Potato|Potatoes]]
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] 

== Equipment ==
* [[Cookbook:Knife|Knife]]
* Pot for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep frying]]
* [[Cookbook:Cooktop|Stovetop]]

== Procedure ==

# Peel the potatoes and rinse under running water.
# Prepare a bowl of cold water. Use a sharp knife or vegetable peeler to make very thin [[Cookbook:Slicing|slices]] of potato, placing them directly into the water.
# Drain off the water, and rinse the potato slices three times with fresh tap water. After the final rinse, cover the potatoes with cold water again.
# Season the potatoes and water with salt, and allow them to brine for a while.
# Drain the potato slices well, removing excess water.
# Heat enough vegetable oil in a pot for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep frying]].
# Working in batches, add the potato slices to the hot oil. Fry, stirring at intervals until the slices are crispy.
# Use a perforated spoon to remove the chips. Place them in a large [[Cookbook:Sieve|sieve]] set over a bowl to drain any excess oil.
# Repeat the frying procedure until all potato slices have been fried.
# Allow the chips to cool before serving.
